title: Rewind of the Candidate Tapes
statement: Let $w,s,v$ be Boolean words, let $o$ be a bit, let $p$ be an input-head position for input $w$, and let $b\in\mathbb{Z}$. For every natural number $j\le |s|$, starting in phase $3$ with $s$ on both the candidate and copy tapes, the third tape holding $v$, and the candidate and copy heads at displacement $j-1$, the preparation machine reaches phase $4$ after exactly $j+1$ steps with both of those heads at the origin; the tape contents, input-head position, flag, and third-tape head position are as specified by that resulting frame.
hypotheses_covered: Integer displacement $b$ of the third-tape head
replaced:
From the preparation machine's candidate-rewind phase with the aligned
candidate and copy heads at displacement $j - 1$, for any $j \le \abs{s}$,
exactly $j+1$ steps restore both heads to the origin without changing
either word; the native input position and the prepared suffix are fixed.
